justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/treevisitor/TreeVisitor.java and ITreeVisitable.java: the package has only two classes and its outgoing dependencies are limited to org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.model types (IMetaMember, IReadOnlyJITDataModel, MetaClass, MetaPackage). Repository-wide references show 6 source packages depend on treevisitor, while 38 source packages import org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.model types, so treevisitor depends on a more stable, widely used package rather than a less stable one.
